name: Gettysburg Battlefield
description: Site of the July 1–3, 1863 Battle of Gettysburg, the bloodiest engagement of the American Civil War. The battlefield and adjacent town are among the most extensively reported haunted locations in the United States, with ghost lore dating back to the immediate aftermath of the battle and a major commercial ghost-tour industry from the 1990s onward.

aliases.name: Ghosts of Gettysburg
aliases.meaning: popular name for the cluster of paranormal traditions associated with the battlefield

origin: Reports are concentrated within the roughly 6,000-acre Gettysburg National Military Park, the borough of Gettysburg, and immediately surrounding farmland in Adams County, Pennsylvania.
